cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.
